exposure: knowledge of HBV infection (general and pregnancy-specific)
receipt of HBV medical care within a year prior to pregnancy
cohort: The study included 510 pregnant hepatitis B virus carriers in Hong Kong, 422 (82.7%) of whom were known carriers.
finding: The knowledge of hepatitis B virus among pregnant carriers in Hong Kong was poor, with only 18.4% having sufficient overall knowledge, though higher education and prior medical care were associated with better knowledge.
cross-section timing: Between August 2019 and April 2021 during pregnancy.
